record.question: The number of Rural Development Blocks in Mizoram at present is
record.explanation: Answer D: 26. Mizoram had 26 Rural Development Blocks in the 2014–15 administrative context. The state's original Economic Survey 2014–15 explicitly states there are 26 RD Blocks under the department, with achievement data through December 2014. Historical/source note: Present means January 2015; do not substitute a later block count. Reference: https://planning.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/645603145da8cf4cabaabb78ca4180ae/economic-survey-2014-15.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
